formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Once submitted, sets the owner's DEGEN allowance for the spender to exactly `value`, replacing any earlier allowance (ERC20Permit.permit calls _approve(owner, spender, value)).
The signature can only be used up to `deadline`. After that it reverts with ERC2612ExpiredSignature.
Uses up the owner's current nonce, so it is single-use. No tokens move when the permit is used.
formats.shown: The intent "Authorize spending of tokens", then the spender address in hex, the max spending amount in DEGEN ("Unlimited" at 2^255 or more), the date it is valid until, and the owner. The nonce is hidden.

findings.title: Permit has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line does not name the token, amount or spender.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats Permit: "intent": "Authorize spending of tokens" with no interpolatedIntent. The fields still show the spender, the value as tokenAmount with tokenPath @.to, and the deadline.
findings.fix: Add "interpolatedIntent": "Allow {spender} to spend up to {value} until {deadline}".
